findings.text: gpt-5.1-thinking shows light regressions vs gpt-5-thinking on harassment, hate, and disallowed sexual content.

source.quote:
The new gpt-5.1-thinking model shows light regressions relative to gpt-5-thinking for content
involving harassment and hateful language, as well as disallowed sexual content.

findings.text: gpt-5.1-instant beats gpt-5-instant-aug15 on all [Production Benchmarks](/evals/openai-production-benchmarks) but is slightly worse than gpt-5-instant-oct3 on sexual, violence, mental health, and emotional reliance.

source.quote:
The new gpt-5.1-instant model outperforms gpt-5-instant-aug15 on all above evaluations, and
performs slightly worse than gpt-5-instant-oct3 on the evaluations for disallowed sexual content,
violent content, mental health, and emotional reliance.

findings.text: Early online A/B measurements of undesired responses in sensitive situations have wide error bars and low statistical confidence.

source.quote:
Given the extremely low prevalence of undesired model responses for sensitive
situations, combined with the relatively small size of A/B tests, these online measurements
have wide error bars.

findings.text: Offline [Production Benchmarks](/evals/openai-production-benchmarks) target hard cases near worst-case and are not representative of average production traffic.

source.quote: Error rates are not representative of average production traffic.

findings.text: gpt-5.1-thinking regresses on self-harm prompts with image inputs versus its GPT-5 predecessor.

source.quote:
We are observing a regression of gpt-5.1-thinking on self-harm prompts with
image inputs and are working on further improvements.

findings.text: Comprehensive safety mitigations for GPT-5.1 Instant and Thinking are largely the same as in the GPT-5 System Card.

source.quote:
The comprehensive safety mitigations for these models are largely the same as we described in
the GPT-5 System Card.

notes: Delta addendum to GPT-5 System Card (basedOn openai-gpt5-system_card). Short 5-page PDF; only baseline safety tables (Production Benchmarks, StrongReject, image-input) plus a Preparedness paragraph—no capability benchmarks or external testers. Instant vs Thinking distinguished via settings.reasoningEffort; gpt-5-instant-aug15 and gpt-5-instant-oct3 left as rawModelName. self-harm/instructions row is split across two PDF lines in pdftotext; quote includes both lines. Online A/B measurements gave no extractable numeric rates (prose only). attack planning gpt-5.1-instant cell is printed as 1.00 (two decimals).
